units.source_text: 女人拘束地动了动脑袋。

en.t: The woman moved her head stiffly.

units.source_text: 既不像点头，又不像摆头。

en.t: It was neither a nod nor a shake of the head.

units.source_text: 举着灯凑近看，想把她那眼色瞧个分明。

en.t: He raised the lamp and leaned closer, trying to make out the look in her eyes.

units.source_text: 男人简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

en.t: The man could hardly believe his own eyes.

units.source_text: 那眼神既没有怨怒，也没有憎恨，只是充满了无限的悲哀，像在倾诉着什么。

en.t: There was neither resentment nor hatred in that look, only an endless sadness, as if it were trying to tell him something.
